criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.note: Opening two lines (~211 chars) clear the LinkedIn see-more cutoff and name two concrete stakes (15,000 shareholders, $54M frozen) plus a structural frame. AI present in line 1. Minor deduction for one figurative phrase.

criteria.name: Industry relevance
criteria.note: All four in-window stories carry a named AK angle and a concrete industry consequence: DOLWD sector figures, NANA Works vendor/platform/first-mover, Murkowski cuts tied to 638 contracts, AFCEC-26-R-0006 live procurement.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.note: Specifics in nearly every sentence: 332,300 nonfarm, -1,900 federal (-12.5%), 4,100 info sector; $58M/<6%/$54M/91 tribes/White Mountain/~$700K; May 26/VOS Sapphire/Geographic Solutions/15,000+; $743.7M BIA/$436.9M BIE/$93M IHS/638; AFCEC-26-R-0006/May 29 to June 29.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.note: DOLWD primary; grid story three outlets; Murkowski Senate primary + Tribal Business News + Indianz. NANA second source BriefGlance is blog-tier (confidence medium); Air Force via HigherGov SAM mirror not direct docket. $700K correctly softened. Two gaps prevent a 10.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.note: Reads like post_001.md: analytical, position-taking, structural, business-literate, no influencer cadence. One brief figurative moment ('two clocks').

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.note: 431 words (in 350-475), 2765 chars (under 3000). Five paragraphs of 3-5 sentences, scans cleanly. Paragraph 2 data-dense but structured.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.note: Real, debatable, tied to the central federal-contraction-vs-AI-buildout tension, names actors (state, ANCs) with a sharpening third option. Slight deduction for the mildly colloquial 'gap year'.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.note: Reader can act on AFCEC-26-R-0006 (June 29), model FY2027 BIA/BIE cuts, reassess tribal grid capital exposure, benchmark NANA Works. Multiple revisit-this triggers.

hard_fail_checks.name: hashtag_count_in_range
hard_fail_checks.note: 5 hashtags, all from the brand whitelist, end-only.

hard_fail_checks.name: punctuation_bans_held
hard_fail_checks.note: Zero em-dashes, en-dashes, double-hyphens, colons, or semicolons in the body.

one_sentence_fix: Upgrade the NANA Works second source from BriefGlance to a second independent credible outlet to close the blog-tier sourcing gap and lift Source quality from 8 to 10.
